Definition: Integration of voter registration data for identity verification, demographic analysis, and service delivery targeting
Comments: No specific evidence found of electoral register integration with the UXP data exchange platform. ANIP manages national ID which is used for voter identification. Smart Africa SATA initiative includes interoperability of identification data but electoral register integration not documented.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0/Unknown was mislabelled: ANIP (the national ID/civil registry authority) is legally mandated to compile and manage Benin's electoral register (Liste Electorale Informatisee, LEI), and government sources confirm the LEI is extracted directly from the Registre National des Personnes Physiques (RNPP), which is described as the single source of electoral data (gouv.bj, Aug 2025). A Feb 2025 ANIP press statement confirms continuous update of the electoral list from RNPP civil-status records (400,000+ death records integrated). ANIP is further extending interoperability (e.g. with the Registre des Beninois de l'Etranger, announced Jul 2025) and hosted ECOWAS/AU delegations in April 2026 who confirmed the integrated model linking population register, civil registry and electoral database. This is not full integration into the broader multi-agency UXP exchange platform in the same way as e.g. tax or banking, so recalculated to 4 (Partially integrated) rather than 5. Recommend human review to confirm whether this operates via UXP proper or as a direct administrative feed, as the distinction affects the precise code.
revised_comments: Benin's electoral register (Liste Electorale Informatisee) is directly derived from and continuously updated against the Registre National des Personnes Physiques (RNPP), the national civil/population registry managed by ANIP. ANIP is mandated under the Electoral Code to compile and manage the electoral list using this single authoritative source, with biometric and nominative data flowing from RNPP into the LEI and periodic reconciliation against civil-status (death) records. ANIP is extending this interoperability to further registers, including the Registre des Beninois de l'Etranger, to support voters abroad. Regional bodies (ECOWAS, African Union) reviewing Benin's 2026 presidential election preparedness in April 2026 confirmed the integrated model linking the population register, civil registry and electoral database.

Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: Open Data portal deployed. Annual APDP compliance reports required from data controllers. Cybernetica publishes performance statistics (3M monthly exchanges, 70M+ total). UN Online Services Index improvements documented. Benin ranked 13th in Africa on UN Online Service Index 2024. Regular biennial evaluations of ASIN conducted.

revision_notes: Confirmed at 3 (Moderate - Annual Reports). Verified that APDP (the data protection authority) is legally required to and does publish annual activity reports covering compliance, control and enforcement actions each year, most recently a 2025 report published June 2026 detailing 907 compliance dossiers and 782 control/litigation cases handled. Biometric Update (Jun 2025) confirms ASIN is deploying 'transparency methods... in gauging progress' on the UXP exchange but no evidence was found of a live public dashboard specifically for data exchange operations (which would justify the top code of 4). The dlapiperdataprotection.com source cited previously covers data protection law generally rather than data-exchange-specific transparency and was not relied upon for this score. Value Name label ('Moderate - Annual Reports') matches the scale wording once whitespace is trimmed; this is cosmetic, not a scoring issue.
revised_comments: Benin publishes annual transparency mechanisms relevant to its data exchange ecosystem rather than a live public dashboard. The data protection authority, APDP, is legally required to and does publish a public annual activity report to the President and National Assembly, covering compliance approvals, inspections, complaints and sanctions (2025 report: 907 compliance dossiers examined, 782 control/litigation cases handled). Cybernetica, the technical partner for the UXP interoperability platform, separately publishes headline usage statistics on data exchange volumes. No dedicated real-time public dashboard for data exchange operations has been identified, so transparency is best characterised as moderate, resting on periodic annual reporting rather than continuous public disclosure.
